Jordan / team — thanks for the ping. Below are concise answers we can share with FintechCorp; attaching the redacted SOC 2 and runbook summary.

1) SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report covering security and availability (period: 2025-07-01 to 2025-12-31). Certified report: SOC2_Report_Redwood_20251115.pdf (attached). We'll provide the redacted PDF under existing NDA terms; if they prefer non-NDA sharing, we can provide the SOC 2 summary and controls matrix instead.

2) Incident response & breach notification:
- Detection & Assessment: Our Security Operations Center (SOC) monitors 24/7 and will triage incidents upon detection.
- Customer Notification: Redwood commits to customer notification within 72 hours of confirmed incidents that materially affect customer data confidentiality, integrity, or availability. For incidents subject to GDPR/HIPAA, we follow regulatory timelines and will provide notification as required; we aim to meet the more stringent timeline when possible.
- Post-Incident Reporting: A technical incident report (high-level) within 7 business days; full RCA and remediation plan within 30 calendar days where feasible.

3) BCP / DR evidence (high level):
- RTO (critical services): 4 hours.
- RPO (critical data): 1 hour.
- Backups: encrypted backups retained for 90 days (configurable for enterprise customers).
- DR runbook: attached summary (BCP_DR_Runbook_Summary.pdf) with test cadence and failover steps — we can share a redacted excerpt.

4) Questionnaire support: We will fill the FintechCorp XLSX for the security and IR sections and return within 2 business days. If they need signed attestations, let me know and we'll route to Legal.

Attachments: SOC2_Report_Redwood_20251115.pdf (redacted), BCP_DR_Runbook_Summary.pdf, SOC2_Controls_Matrix.xlsx
